prompt: The kabuki actor holds his fierce pose, then slowly releases it: his spread hands lower and come to rest in his lap, his tense shoulders soften, and his glare settles into a calm, focused gaze. His topknot and hair disappear, leaving a shaved bald head, and his striped robe becomes a soft green robe. The dark grey mica background lightens into pale cream paper. He becomes an elderly bald painter, Hokusai, seated quietly with a calm, dignified expression. Soft Japanese brush painting style, light colors on paper. One continuous transformation, not a fade or dissolve. Motion design for a large digital signage screen in a modern train station concourse: dynamic cinematic camera moves, layered parallax depth, crisp confident timing, and a refined, elegant Japanese atmosphere. Everything moves as if truly alive. Keep the flat ukiyo-e look: crisp ink outlines, flat colors, washi paper texture, no realistic shading.
